KnowledgeBaseUrl.title: Knowledge Base Url
KnowledgeBaseUrl.description: If configured, a menu item "Knowledge base" will show up where the user can browse the page from the UI.

MenuShowIdentity.title: Show Identity Menu Item
MenuShowIdentity.description: Configures whether to show the Identity menu item. Defaults to true

MenuShowApps.title: Show Apps Menu Item
MenuShowApps.description: Configures whether to show the Apps menu item. Defaults to true

MenuShowSelfService.title: Show Self Service Menu Item
MenuShowSelfService.description: Configures whether to show the Self Service menu item. Defaults to true

MenuShowCompanyPortal.title: Show Company Portal Menu Item
MenuShowCompanyPortal.description: Configures whether to show the Company Portal menu item. Defaults to true

MenuShowKnowledgeBase.title: Show Knowledge Base Menu Item
MenuShowKnowledgeBase.description: Configures whether to show the Knowledge Base menu item. Defaults to true

BrandName.title: Brand Name
BrandName.description: Configures the name shown in the navigation menu.

AccentColor.title: Accent Color
AccentColor.description: Configures the brand color shown in the app, specify in hex format.

BrandLogo.title: Brand Logo
BrandLogo.description: Configures the brand logo shown in the apps side menu. Specify a Base64 string.

BrandLogoLight.title: Brand Logo Light
BrandLogoLight.description: Configures the brand logo shown in the apps side menu when light theme is used. Specify a base64 string

SupportPageUrl.title: Support Page URL
SupportPageUrl.description: Configures the URL to open when the user clicks on the Get Support button.

ChangePasswordUrl.title: Change Password URL
ChangePasswordUrl.description: Configures the URL to open when the user clicks on the Change Password button.

ChangePasswordMode.title: Change Password Mode
ChangePasswordMode.description: Configures the mode for the Change Password button, available modes are: local, SSOExtension, url. Defaults to local if not configured.

SupportEmail.title: Support Email
SupportEmail.description: Configures the email address shown when the user clicks on the Support Info button.

SupportPhone.title: Support Phone
SupportPhone.description: Configures the phone number shown when the user clicks on the Support Info button.

HiddenCards.title: Hidden Cards
HiddenCards.description: Configures which cards to hide, available cards are: DeviceInformation, Evergreen, Battery, Actions, ApplicationInstallProgress, Storage, DeviceManagement, PendingAppUpdates, Jamf, Fleet, FleetPolicies.

HiddenActions.title: Hidden Actions
HiddenActions.description: Configures which actions to hide, available actions are: ChangePassword, Reboot, OpenManagementApp, GetSupport, GatherLogs, SoftwareUpdates, RestartIntuneAgent.

NotificationInterval.title: Notification Interval
NotificationInterval.description: Configures the interval for notifications in hours for Application Updates and Software Updates notifications.

NotificationTitle.title: Notification Title
NotificationTitle.description: Configures the title for notifications for notifications. Defaults to Support Companion if not configured.

NotificationImage.title: Notification Image
NotificationImage.description: Configures an image to add to notifications. Local path should be specified.

SoftwareUpdateNotificationMessage.title: Software Update Notification Message
SoftwareUpdateNotificationMessage.default: Software Updates Available. Please update your device to the latest version.
SoftwareUpdateNotificationMessage.description: Configures the message for notifications for Software Updates notifications. Defaults to "Software Updates Available. Please update your device to the latest version." if not configured.

SoftwareUpdateNotificationButtonText.title: Software Update Notification Button Text
SoftwareUpdateNotificationButtonText.description: Configures the button text for notifications for Software Updates notifications. Defaults to "Update Now 🚀" if not configured.

AppUpdateNotificationMessage.title: App Update Notification Message
AppUpdateNotificationMessage.default: App Updates Available. Please update your apps to the latest version.
AppUpdateNotificationMessage.description: Configures the message for notifications for App Updates notifications. Defaults to "App Updates Available. Please update your apps to the latest version." if not configured.

AppUpdateNotificationButtonText.title: App Update Notification Button Text
AppUpdateNotificationButtonText.description: Configures the button text for notifications for App Updates notifications. Defaults to "Update Now 🚀" if not configured.

RebootReminderDays.title: Reboot Reminder Days
RebootReminderDays.description: Configures the number of days after which the user will be reminded to reboot. Defaults to 0 days if not configured (no reminder).

Mode.title: Mode
Mode.description: Configures which source the app reads application information from. Detection runs only when this is empty: Fleet is chosen on Macs running Fleet's agent (orbit) when no other mode matches.

RefreshSelfService.title: Refresh Self Service
RefreshSelfService.description: Configures whether to refresh the Self Service+ app data in the background when in Jamf mode. Defaults to true

JamfLogPollHours.title: Jamf Log Poll Hours
JamfLogPollHours.description: Configures how often to poll Jamf logs in hours. Only used when in Jamf mode. Defaults to 36 if not configured.

LogFolders.title: Log Folders
LogFolders.description: Configures the log folders to gather logs from. Only used when gathering logs. Defaults to "/Library/Logs/Microsoft" if not configured.

ExcludedLogFolders.title: Excluded Log Folders
ExcludedLogFolders.description: Configures the log folders to exclude when gathering logs. Only used when gathering logs.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: Name of the action to show in the menu.

Command.title: Command
Command.description: Command to run when to item is clicked.

Icon.title: Icon
Icon.description: SF Symbol to show in the Self Service page in the UI.

IsPrivileged.title: Is Privileged
IsPrivileged.description: SF Symbol to show in the Self Service page in the UI.

Description.title: Description
Description.description: Description to show in the Self Service page in the UI.

ButtonLabel.title: Button Label
ButtonLabel.description: Configures the button label for the action.

Actions.title: Actions
Actions.description: Configures custom actions to add to the tray menu. Actions defined in the user's own preferences still run, but IsPrivileged is honored only when the action comes from a configuration profile. From 3.0 the app sends only the action's name and the helper looks the command up itself, so a privileged action must be defined in a profile to run at all.

ShowLogoInTrayMenu.title: Show Logo In Tray Menu
ShowLogoInTrayMenu.description: Configures whether to show the branding logo in the tray menu. Defaults to true.

TrayMenuBrandingIcon.title: Tray Menu Branding Icon
TrayMenuBrandingIcon.description: Configures the icon to show in the tray menu. Specify a Base64 string.

TrayMenuShowIcon.title: Show Tray Menu Icon
TrayMenuShowIcon.description: Configures whether to show the tray menu icon. Useful if you only want to show desktop information for example. Defaults to true.

DesktopInfoWindowPosition.title: Desktop Position
DesktopInfoWindowPosition.description: Configures the position of the desktop info. Defaults to Lower Right.

DesktopInfoLevel.title: Desktop Info Level
DesktopInfoLevel.description: Configures the level of information to show on the desktop. Defaults to 4.

DesktopInfoHideItems.title: Desktop Info Hide Items
DesktopInfoHideItems.description: Use this array to determine which information to hide. Available items are: HostName, Model, SerialNumber, Processor, IPAddress, Memory, OSBuild, OSVersion, LastRestart, FileVault, StorageName, SupportPhone, SupportEmail. It is also possible to hide entire sections: Hardware Specifications, System Information, Network Information, Storage, Support.

DesktopInfoBackgroundOpacity.title: Desktop Info Background Opacity
DesktopInfoBackgroundOpacity.description: Configures the opacity of the desktop info. Defaults to 0%.

DesktopInfoBackgroundFrosted.title: Desktop Info Background Frosted
DesktopInfoBackgroundFrosted.description: Enables a frosted glass look on the desktop info when set to true.

DesktopInfoFontSize.title: Desktop Info Font Size
DesktopInfoFontSize.description: Configures the font size for the desktop info. Defaults to 14.

CustomCardPath.title: Custom Card Path
CustomCardPath.description: Configures a path to a JSON file containing custom widgets to show on the Home view.

DebugLogging.title: Debug Logging
DebugLogging.description: Configures whether debug logging is enabled. Defaults to false.

EnableElevation.title: Enable Elevation
EnableElevation.description: When set to true allows the user to elevate to admin during a set time frame. Defaults to false. From 3.0 this is only honored when it comes from a configuration profile.

RequireResonForElevation.title: Require Reason For Elevation
RequireResonForElevation.description: Requires the user to enter a reason for the elevation. Defaults to false. From 3.0 this is only honored when it comes from a configuration profile.

ReasonMinLength.title: Reason Min Length
ReasonMinLength.description: Set a minimum amount of characters the user must enter as the reason. Defaults to 10. From 3.0 this is only honored when it comes from a configuration profile.

MaxElevationTime.title: Max Elevation Time
MaxElevationTime.description: The amount of time (in minutes) the user is elevated. Defaults to 5. From 3.0 this is only honored when it comes from a configuration profile.

ElevationWebhookUrl.title: Elevation Webhook Url
ElevationWebhookUrl.description: When configured, sends the entered elevation reason to a webhook instead of saving to disk. From 3.0 this is only honored when it comes from a configuration profile.

ShowElevateTrayCard.title: Show Elevate Tray Card
ShowElevateTrayCard.description: Configure wether to show the elevate button in the tray menu or not. Defaults to false.

ElevationSeverity.title: Elevation Severity
ElevationSeverity.description: Configure the elevation severity. Defaults to 6 (Informational). From 3.0 this is only honored when it comes from a configuration profile.

MarkdownFilePath.title: Markdown File Path
MarkdownFilePath.description: Configure a path to a Markdown file to show in the menu.

MarkdownMenuLabel.title: Markdown Menu Label
MarkdownMenuLabel.description: Configure the menu label for the custom Markdown view.

MarkdownMenuIcon.title: Markdown Menu Icon
MarkdownMenuIcon.description: Configure the icon for the custom Markdown menu item.

CustomCardsMenuLabel.title: Custom Cards Menu Label
CustomCardsMenuLabel.description: Configure the menu label for the custom cards view.

CustomCardsMenuIcon.title: Custom Cards Menu Icon
CustomCardsMenuIcon.description: Configure the icon for the custom cards menu item.

RequirePrivilegedActionAuthentication.title: Require Privileged Action Authentication
RequirePrivilegedActionAuthentication.description: Requires the user to authenticate before a privileged action runs. From 3.0 this defaults to true unless an administrator sets it, and is honored only from a configuration profile.

EnforceAdminAllowlist.title: Enforce Admin Allowlist
EnforceAdminAllowlist.description: When true, the helper reconciles the admin group at startup and every five minutes: any account holding administrator rights that is neither listed in PermanentAdmins nor inside a live elevation window is demoted. Set PermanentAdmins before enabling this, or those accounts are demoted within five minutes. Defaults to false. Must be delivered in a device-scoped configuration profile; it is ignored anywhere else.

PermanentAdmins.title: Permanent Admins
PermanentAdmins.description: Accounts that may hold administrator rights permanently when EnforceAdminAllowlist is enabled. List every such account: management accounts, break-glass accounts, permanently administrative staff, and anything granted rights by another system such as Platform SSO's AdministratorGroups. An explicitly empty array is honored and means no account is a permanent administrator; a missing list is refused with an error rather than acted on. root is always permitted. Must be delivered in a device-scoped configuration profile; it is ignored anywhere else.

ElevationAllowedAdmins.title: Elevation Allowed Admins
ElevationAllowedAdmins.description: Accounts the elevation watchdog ignores, for management accounts an MDM may legitimately add while somebody is elevated. Defaults to an empty list. Must be delivered in a device-scoped configuration profile; it is ignored anywhere else.

EnableUserInstalls.title: Enable User Installs
EnableUserInstalls.description: When true, a standard user can install a .pkg or .dmg listed in AllowedInstallers without holding administrator rights. Both the app and the helper read this: the app decides whether to stage a file at all, the helper decides whether to install it. Defaults to false. Read only from a configuration profile, device-scoped or scoped to the user being served.

ShowInstallerServiceMenuItem.title: Show Installer Service Menu Item
ShowInstallerServiceMenuItem.description: Whether Finder's context menu offers "Install with Support Companion". Follows EnableUserInstalls unless set explicitly; set it to false to keep user installs but route everyone through the in-app catalog. Applied on every launch.

RequireAuthenticationForInstalls.title: Require Authentication For Installs
RequireAuthenticationForInstalls.description: Whether the user authenticates before a user install proceeds. They authenticate as themselves, not as an administrator. Turning this off means an unlocked unattended Mac is enough to install an allowlisted item. Defaults to true.

UserInstallFallback.title: User Install Fallback
UserInstallFallback.description: What to offer when an installer is not on the allowlist. "installer" opens it in Apple's Installer, "elevate" offers the normal time-limited elevation instead, "none" offers nothing. Defaults to "installer".

SkipHelperInstall.title: Skip Helper Install
SkipHelperInstall.description: When true, the package does not install or load its own copy of the privileged helper, and removes any it finds. Set this only where the helper is deployed declaratively with com.apple.configuration.services.background-tasks, otherwise two daemons claim the same Mach service. Defaults to false. Must be delivered in a device-scoped configuration profile; it is ignored anywhere else.

FleetUrl.title: Fleet URL
FleetUrl.description: Overrides the Fleet server URL otherwise discovered from fleetd or orbit. Read only from a configuration profile, because the device's token is sent to whatever server this names.

FleetRecommendedApps.title: Fleet Recommended Apps
FleetRecommendedApps.description: Fleet software keys pinned to the top of the self-service catalog, whether or not they are already installed.

FleetRecommendedTitle.title: Fleet Recommended Title
FleetRecommendedTitle.description: Renames the recommended section of the Fleet catalog.

FleetIconsFromGitHub.title: Fleet Icons From GitHub
FleetIconsFromGitHub.description: Whether to fetch application icons from Fleet's public catalog on GitHub. Defaults to true.

FleetAppOpenMessages.title: Fleet App Open Messages
FleetAppOpenMessages.description: Replaces the built-in wording shown when an install is waiting for the user to quit the application first.

FleetButtonLabels.title: Fleet Button Labels
FleetButtonLabels.description: Custom button text in the Fleet catalog, keyed by software title and optionally nested by action.

Title.description: Software title, or an action name nested under one.

FleetNotifyUpdates.title: Fleet Notify Updates
FleetNotifyUpdates.description: Notify when Fleet reports available application updates. Defaults to true.

FleetNotifyInstallResults.title: Fleet Notify Install Results
FleetNotifyInstallResults.description: Notify when a Fleet install, update or uninstall finishes. Defaults to true.

FleetNotifyPolicies.title: Fleet Notify Policies
FleetNotifyPolicies.description: Notify when Fleet policies are failing on the Mac. Defaults to true.

FleetNotifySignIn.title: Fleet Notify Sign In
FleetNotifySignIn.description: Remind the user to sign in to Fleet Desktop SSO while signed out, at most once a day. Defaults to false, unlike the other Fleet notifications.

CompanyPortalUrl.title: Company Portal URL
CompanyPortalUrl.description: Overrides the Company Portal URL, for sovereign cloud endpoints such as GCC High.

SoftwareUpdateNotificationCommand.title: Software Update Notification Command
SoftwareUpdateNotificationCommand.description: Command run when the software update notification's button is clicked. Defaults to opening the Software Update pane.

AppUpdateNotificationCommand.title: App Update Notification Command
AppUpdateNotificationCommand.description: Command run when the application update notification's button is clicked. Set at every launch to open the management application for the detected mode; a value forced by profile still wins.

FileDebugLogging.title: File Debug Logging
FileDebugLogging.description: Write debug logging to disk as well as to the unified log. Defaults to false.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: Display name for this entry. Required.

SHA256.title: SHA256
SHA256.description: 64 hex characters. When present the entry is strict: it pins one exact build and stops matching as soon as the vendor ships an update.

TeamID.title: Team ID
TeamID.description: The signing team. Required whenever SHA256 is absent.

LeafCertificateSHA256.title: Leaf Certificate SHA256
LeafCertificateSHA256.description: Pins the signing certificate itself. Stricter than TeamID, and needs updating when the vendor renews.

PackageIdentifier.title: Package Identifier
PackageIdentifier.description: Package identifiers this entry allows, for a .pkg. A distribution package needs every component listed. A single string is also accepted.

BundleIdentifier.title: Bundle Identifier
BundleIdentifier.description: Bundle identifiers this entry allows, for the application inside a .dmg. A single string is also accepted.

AllowAnyIdentifier.title: Allow Any Identifier
AllowAnyIdentifier.description: Accept anything the named team signs. This is a vendor allowlist rather than an application allowlist. Defaults to false.

MinimumVersion.title: Minimum Version
MinimumVersion.description: Refuse builds older than this, so a signed but vulnerable version cannot be installed instead.

RequireNotarized.title: Require Notarized
RequireNotarized.description: Require the installer to be notarized. Defaults to true.

AllowScripts.title: Allow Scripts
AllowScripts.description: Whether the package may carry install scripts. A scriptless package landing in /Applications is a file copy; one with a postinstall is arbitrary root code on every future build the vendor signs. Defaults to false.

AllowedPayloadPrefixes.title: Allowed Payload Prefixes
AllowedPayloadPrefixes.description: Absolute path prefixes this installer may write to. Unrestricted when unset, though some destinations always need naming explicitly.

AllowUnrestrictedPayload.title: Allow Unrestricted Payload
AllowUnrestrictedPayload.description: Lets this installer write anywhere, including the destinations that otherwise always need naming. Its own key, so the most dangerous setting has to be meant. Defaults to false.

AllowedInstallers.title: Allowed Installers
AllowedInstallers.description: Installers a standard user may install without administrator rights when EnableUserInstalls is true. The helper re-reads this and re-derives the installer's facts before it acts, so the confirmation sheet the user sees is presentation only. Entries that cannot decide anything are dropped and logged. Read only from a configuration profile, device-scoped or scoped to the user being served.
